note: Mid-run infrastructure change decided by the human (specimen commit ad122f7): the Worker shell is now open with a denylist (sudo, curl, wget, ssh, scp, nc) instead of an allowlist. Real boundaries remain token scopes, rulesets, interaction limits and the disposable runner. The Queen stays restricted to gh and was told how to view CI screenshots via gh run download.
